Beauty.subject: Creative Agency-Decision Pinnacle
Beauty.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I am reaching out regarding your LinkedIn post scouting for digital marketing agencies. I would like to take this opportunity to introduce Decison Pinnacle, a new age marketing consultancy driving counterculture.

We drive growth through performance marketing on D2C, Marketplace and Quick Commerce for brands like Conscious Chemist, Sadhev, and Typsy Beauty. We were the creative agency behind the launch of Mimiq, which won the Beauty and You 2026 award presented by Estee Lauder and Nykaa.

Some of our recent launches include Macros.Live—a men's skin fitness brand that tries to uncomplicate skincare for men—and the perfume brand Fifth Sense which is India's first climate-conscious Perfume brand.

Pls find the attached detailed note for your ready reference.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZagH-hoioCFoLUo9ckAuXLnQFJQyBQkS/view?usp=sharing

Look forward to hearing from you .

Thanks & Regards
Deepti Karthik

Apparel.subject: Creative Agency-Decision Pinnacle
Apparel.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I am reaching out regarding your LinkedIn post scouting for digital marketing agencies. I would like to take this opportunity to introduce Decison Pinnacle, a new age marketing consultancy driving counterculture.

As an organisation we have had the chance to work on diverse sectors from FMCG, BPC,Apparel,Kids,GM etc.  Some of the brands we have worked on include ARKS ,Sleepyhead,Superbottoms, Koparo,VI John, MyFrido,Conscious Chemist, Basil , Sadhev among others who we have helped unlock growth through creative and performance marketing expertise 

We are a full funnel partner through insight to execution, helping build brand identity, brand book, helping do catalogue, lifestyle shoots, run social media and performance marketing campaigns to aid in holistic growth. Please find attached a note on us along with some case studies for your ready reference and review.
